tips.title: Dodging Aatrox's Q Skill
tips.tip: Aatrox's Q skill deals bonus damage and knocks up enemies hit by the edge. It's crucial to use your E skill to either dash inside Aatrox's Q range or dodge to the side.

tips.title: Disabling Aatrox with Empowered W
tips.tip: Aatrox maximizes his healing by adjusting his position with E while casting Q. Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator) has a shield break effect, allowing you to nullify Aatrox's healing and gain an advantage in trades.
